title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Discover the best environments for focus and collaboration across the Drew University campus, from silent library zones to active student lounges.

cards.title: Silent Focus in the Kean Room
cards.subtitle: Rose Memorial Library Level C
cards.notes: Located on Level C of the Rose Wing, this room is a designated silent zone for individual study. It offers a traditional academic atmosphere for deep concentration.
cards.short_summary: A designated silent study room located on Level C of the Rose Memorial Library's Rose Wing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kean Room on Level C is designated as a silent zone for individual study.
cards.source_title: Find Your Zone|Silent, Quiet, Social and Hybrid - Drew University
cards.access_notes: Open during regular library hours; accessible to students with a valid Drew ID during extended study hours.

cards.title: Graduate Study in the Baldwin Room
cards.subtitle: Rose Memorial Library Level E
cards.notes: Found on Level E, this silent zone is specifically tailored for graduate students and those seeking a strictly quiet environment for research and writing.
cards.short_summary: A silent study area on Level E of the library, often used by graduate students for quiet research.
cards.evidence_claim: The Baldwin Room on Level E is a designated silent zone for individual study.
cards.source_title: Find Your Zone|Silent, Quiet, Social and Hybrid - Drew University
cards.access_notes: Accessible during library hours; designated as a silent zone.

cards.title: Collaborative Work at the Atrium
cards.subtitle: Rose Memorial Library Level C
cards.notes: The entrance atrium on Level C is a social zone. It is ideal for group projects and casual study where conversation is permitted and encouraged.
cards.short_summary: A social study zone located at the main entrance of the Rose Memorial Library on Level C.
cards.evidence_claim: The entrance atrium area on Level C is designated as a social zone for collaboration and group study.
cards.source_title: Find Your Zone|Silent, Quiet, Social and Hybrid - Drew University
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; allows for social interaction and group work.

cards.title: Tech-Equipped Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Rose Memorial Library Level C
cards.notes: Reserve one of the glassed-in rooms on Level C featuring large-screen monitors and whiteboard walls. Perfect for presentations and collaborative sessions.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group study rooms on Level C equipped with monitors and whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: The library has group study spaces on Level C with large-screen monitors and whiteboard walls available for reservation.
cards.source_title: Find Your Zone|Silent, Quiet, Social and Hybrid - Drew University
cards.access_notes: Available for Drew students and faculty in groups of two or more; can be reserved online.

cards.title: Casual Study at the 1867 Lounge
cards.subtitle: Ehinger Center
cards.notes: Located in the Ehinger Center, this lounge offers comfortable seating and a warm atmosphere. It is a popular spot for students to work between classes.
cards.short_summary: A comfortable student lounge located within the Ehinger Center (EC) for casual study.
cards.evidence_claim: The 1867 Lounge in the Ehinger Center is a place where students can relax and work in comfy chairs.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Best Study Spots at Drew - The Drew Acorn
cards.access_notes: Open during Ehinger Center building hours, typically 7:00am to 10:00pm on weekdays.

cards.title: Coffee and Collaboration at Brothers College
cards.subtitle: Brothers College
cards.notes: Study with a caffeine boost at the Peet's Coffee location inside Brothers College. This area provides a more active environment for social learners.
cards.short_summary: A study area located near Peet's Coffee within the Brothers College academic building.
cards.evidence_claim: Students can study at Peet's Coffee located in Brothers College.
cards.source_title: Top 5 places to study off campus near Drew University
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building and cafe operating hours.

cards.title: Serene Study at Faulkner House
cards.subtitle: Faulkner House
cards.notes: This lounge in the Anthropology department offers natural light, cultural art, and wooden tables. It is known for its quiet and serene atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, art-filled lounge located in Faulkner House, home to the Anthropology department.
cards.evidence_claim: The lounge at Faulkner House is described as serene, full of natural light, and featuring wooden tables and leather couches.
cards.source_title: Top 10 Best Study Spots at Drew - The Drew Acorn
cards.access_notes: Located within the Anthropology department; typically open during academic building hours.

cards.title: Theological Research in the Cornell Room
cards.subtitle: Rose Memorial Library Level E
cards.notes: A designated quiet zone on Level E, the Cornell Room houses theological reference materials and provides a low-conversation environment for group study.
cards.short_summary: A quiet zone on Level E of the library used for theological reference and group study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cornell Room on Level E is designated as a quiet zone for low brief conversation while studying as a group.
cards.source_title: Find Your Zone|Silent, Quiet, Social and Hybrid - Drew University
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; designated as a quiet zone.

cards.title: Private Study in Day Carrels
cards.subtitle: Rose Memorial Library
cards.notes: Check out a private, cubicle-like room for the day at the circulation desk. These carrels offer maximum privacy for intensive individual work.
cards.short_summary: Small, private rooms available for daily checkout at the library circulation desk.
cards.evidence_claim: The library offers five Day Carrels (small, cubicle-like rooms) that can be checked out for the day at the circulation desk.
cards.source_title: Library Services and Resources - Drew University
cards.access_notes: Available for daily checkout at the circulation desk on a first-come, first-served basis.

cards.title: Quiet Reflection at Seminary Hall
cards.subtitle: Seminary Hall
cards.notes: Seminary Hall features lounges and common areas with a fireplace, providing a majestic and quiet setting for study and reflection.
cards.short_summary: Common areas and lounges within Seminary Hall, home to the Theological School.
cards.evidence_claim: Seminary Hall includes lounges and a common area fireplace, creating an accommodating campus experience.
cards.source_title: Our Community. The Student Experience | Drew University
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; primarily serves the Theological School community.
